steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hurry up, Laios.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Look at this mushroom! Even the dungeon's walking mushrooms don't grow this big!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Wouldn't it be amazing to see a walking mushroom this size...? Thoughts on having it for lunch later?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Careful now. The Gourmet Guide says jungle mushrooms are basically all poisonous to some extent.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: For example, they might give you full body rashes, thicken your blood, or make you throw up nonstop until every organ is down on the floor...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...I'd rather not think about what the guide's author must have been through to learn all that in such detail.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: The orcs only taught me how to identify dungeon mushrooms, so we'd best leave these alone.

spans.text: The orcs only taught me how to identify
mushrooms, so we'd best leave these alone.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But there are some animals that eat them!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Still no. If only one or two critters consider it edible, it means it's probably toxic to everything else.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: In other words, if we see lots of animals eating this, then it's likely to be edible for us, too.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Right...
(Low roar)

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: What was that?
(Piercing buzzing)

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: There's something flying towards us! Careful, everyone!

steps.name: Laios's Party
steps.text: WAAAAAAHHHH!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: (Knocks here and there)

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Ha! Now that was an impressive explosion!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: A good thing the test site was empty.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Chamber pressure, off the charts. Same goes for temperature readings, and load capacity too!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Seems like it'll need reinforcement to perform well.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Next, final adjustments to the previous configuration, loosen the belt, tighten the screws, and... done!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: My newest masterpiece, the 'Invincible Cool Thing' will be fully operational. As long as I don't run into another accident!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, I should get rid of all these explosives first.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Safety first! Avoid open flames...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: (Knocks here and there)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: *cough* *cough* That thing over there keeps blowing up...!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You alright, Marcille?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I-I'm fine! Just a little dizzy...
(Low roar)

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: There's more...! Careful!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: A golem? Maybe a gargoyle?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Taste my magic—
BOOM—!!!
High Priest, High Priest? You there?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...What was that?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: —Wagh!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: A crocodile?! Or a beast-man with a crocodile head?!

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Huh? What's a beast-man?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: He can speak too!

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Why wouldn't I be able to? Hey, you there, Durins, did you crawl up from the underground?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: 'Durins'?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Is he talking about us?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: See any other short ones around here?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Are you saying me and Chilchuck look like the same race to you?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Don't you guys have 'Half-foot' here?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: ...What are you talking about? Is something wrong with you all?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Right, have you seen our High Priest here?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: High Priest?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Old guy, shorter than me, wears glasses.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's he doing in such a dangerous place?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Dunno. He thinks in mysterious ways.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, we haven't run into any old men.

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: He also moves in mysterious ways.

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Guess I should just give up and get back to the tribe, then. Like all the times I went out and looked for him before.

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Goodbye, strange tourists!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wait! Could I ask if you've heard of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Heh. Lucky for you, but also unlucky. Because I feel like I have, but also not.

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: There's someone else in the tribe who I'm sure knows where this Whatever Island is though.

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: But that person happens to be...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: That High Priest you're looking for?

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Bingo.

steps.name: Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: How's this? Come back with me. We hardly ever find him when we go looking, but he always comes back sooner or later.

steps.name: Bright Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: So basically, you guys were on an island with a huge dungeon, and somehow ended up here?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: More or less. Do you know anything about it?

steps.name: Bright Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: Uh... What's an island?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Huh? It's... a landmass completely surrounded by sea.

steps.name: Bright Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: What's a sea?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Um... a large body of water?

steps.name: Bright Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: You mean a lake? You really like to use strange words.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Well, is it because we're inland right now and you haven't heard of...

steps.name: Bright Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: It's because your questions are so strange! I've never heard of a sea, an island, or a Merini Village. Were you swept here from the other side of Terra by someone's tail or something?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: 'Terra'?

steps.name: Bright Gator-headed Beast-man
steps.text: It's what we're standing on right now.
Marcille tries to read the crocodile man's face for any sign he was pranking her.
Unfortunately, the only message she gets from his eyes is 'Am I talking to a fool?'

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: So in short, the one who calls the shots in this tribe of crocodiles—er, Archosauria—is the High Priest. The one Marcille blew up earlier was his...

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: His mech.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: The 'Invincible Cool Thing.'

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: But if we blew up his 'mech'... would he still be willing to help us find Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: It's fine. It would've exploded with or without you.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Always manages to blow up somehow.

steps.name: Bright Archosauria
steps.text: The High Priest is a friendly man. I'm sure he won't blame you if you just explain everything.

steps.name: Bright Archosauria
steps.text: He's also a righteous man. He wouldn't leave a group of lost visitors stranded.

steps.name: Bright Archosauria
steps.text: That's our High Priest!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Still, we should come up with a way to make amends.

steps.name: Bright Archosauria
steps.text: Don't worry about it—wait, what's that good smell? Who's cooking today?

steps.name: Archosauria Warrior
steps.text: The Durin with the huge beard.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Terra, Acahualla, living paintings, the dungeon...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ugh... I can't wrap my head around it all.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I can use magic here, so at the very least some of the laws of reality are shared...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Falin... I bet I'd be as excited as Laios if you were here.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *sigh* I miss our days back at the academy.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Back then...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wait, the berries that those little birds are eating...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: They look like that fruit Falin offered me back then...

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Smells great. Are Durins good at cooking too?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: For the last time, I'm not a Durin... *sigh* Never mind, suit yourself.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Quick, round everyone up to try out this bearded Durin's cooking!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Right, you guys were looking for the High Priest?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yeah. We want to ask him some questions.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: It's true he knows much, but it's hard to meet him. It's easy if he wants to see you; but impossible if he doesn't.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Sounds like your classic sage type... So how do we get him to want to see us?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Hmm... Zumama said that if we wanted the High Priest to share his wisdom, we should make some noise to attract him!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Noise... would a big feast count?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Yeah. Something like that.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: No objections here. Let's ask Marcille what she thinks.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Speaking of which, where is she?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: She hasn't returned yet?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Damn you, Red Dragon! GIVE FALIN BACK TO ME!!!
